scene: one adult strides across a flat field with a bag hanging at the hip, one arm swung out wide and small seeds flying in an arc from the open hand.
must: an open hand swung wide with seeds flying out in an arc across a field.
avoid: a ball thrown in a straight line (gooien); a seedling pressed into the ground (planten); a watering can over a row of plants (gieten); a hand holding one seed (pakken).
alt: Iemand loopt over een veld met een zak aan de heup en laat zaadjes in een boog uit een open hand vliegen.
column6: Hij verspreidt zaad over het veld.
column7: He spreads seed over the field.

scene: one student stands in front of a wide board with a sheet pinned on it, both fists raised and the mouth wide open, one foot lifted from the floor; a second student behind watches with the hands pressed together under the chin.
must: a student with both fists in the air in front of a board with a pinned sheet.
avoid: a person hitting a nail with a hammer (slaan); a person crying at a desk (huilen); a person crossing a finish line (winnen); a person reading a sheet with a frown (lezen); a person receiving a medal (krijgen).
alt: Een leerling houdt beide vuisten omhoog voor een prikbord met een vel erop; een tweede kijkt toe.
column6: Ik hoop dat ik slaag voor mijn examen.
column7: I hope I pass my exam.

scene: SKIP: limiting is abstract; a fence or a cut-off line would read as afsluiten or a rule rather than the verb.
One adult at a table holds a coin above the slot in the back of a pig-shaped money box; a short row of coins stands on edge beside it.
must: A coin held at the slot of a pig-shaped money box.
avoid: a coin dropping into a plant pot (investeren); coins handed to a seller (betalen); a person counting coins (tellen); a person carrying a shopping bag (kopen).
alt: Iemand houdt een muntje boven de gleuf van een potje in de vorm van een varken op tafel.
column6: Zij besparen elke maand geld door thuis te koken.
column7: They save money every month by cooking at home.

scene: SKIP: communicating is two people with a bar each above the head, which is praten on the A1 page.

one adult stands in a plain room holding a wooden chair off the floor with both hands, carrying it from the left side towards a pale square marked on the floor at the right, one step taken. Nothing else in the picture.
must: a chair lifted off the floor and carried from one spot to another.
avoid: a person dragging a chair along the floor (slepen); a person sitting down on the chair (zitten); a box carried to a doorway (dragen); a trolley pushed along (duwen); arrows or dotted paths.
alt: Iemand draagt een stoel met twee handen van de ene plek in de kamer naar een andere plek.

scene: two adults stand facing each other an arm's length apart. The one on the left holds out a plate with a slice of cake; the one on the right holds one flat open palm up and forward to keep it away, chin turned slightly aside, eyes on the plate. Above the head of the person refusing (palm up) floats one bold solid cobalt arrow pointing straight down at the head, with a clear white gap between arrow tip and hair; it marks who performs the verb. The other person has no arrow. No text.
must: a flat palm held up against an offered plate while the head turns away.
avoid: a plate handed over and taken in both hands (geven); a person eating the cake (eten); a hand raised in a wave (zwaaien); only a head shaking with no plate (nee zeggen); a crossed-out symbol.
alt: Twee mensen staan tegenover elkaar; de een biedt een bord met taart aan, de ander houdt een open hand ervoor.

scene: one adult bows forward from the waist with one hand pressed flat on the chest, facing a second adult who stands upright with a small smile.
must: an adult bowing forward from the waist with one hand on the chest toward a second adult.
avoid: two adults shaking hands (begroeten); an adult handing a box to another (geven); a person waving (zwaaien); a person asking with a raised hand (vragen).
alt: Iemand buigt vanuit het middel naar een ander met een hand op de borst; de ander glimlacht.
column6: Ik dank u voor uw hulp.
column7: I thank you for your help.

scene: SKIP: committing a crime or an act is abstract, and any picture would be the crime itself, such as stelen, rather than plegen.

two adults stand facing each other an arm's length apart, each holding out one object to the other: the left person an apple, the right person a loaf of bread. Both objects are caught halfway, side by side between the two pairs of hands. Both look at what they are about to receive.
must: two different objects passing in opposite directions between two people.
avoid: one box passing one way only (geven); coins and notes on a counter (betalen); two people shaking hands (groeten); a shop shelf with a price (kopen); a ring of arrows.
alt: Twee mensen staan tegenover elkaar en houden elk een ander voorwerp naar de ander uit; de voorwerpen kruisen elkaar.

scene: one adult stands between two closed doors of the same shape and pushes one of them open with a straight arm and a firm stride; the other door stays shut.
must: a straight arm pushing one of two doors open.
avoid: a hand held above one of two jars (kiezen); a person scratching the head between two doors (twijfelen); a person opening a single door (openen); a person waiting still (wachten).
alt: Iemand staat tussen twee deuren en duwt er met een gestrekte arm een naar binnen.
column6: Wij beslissen morgen wat we gaan doen.
column7: We decide tomorrow what we are going to do.

scene: one adult sits leaning back on a plain park bench, arms spread along the backrest and legs stretched out and crossed at the ankle, eyes open and looking at the sky, shoulders loose. Nothing else in the picture.
must: a person leaning fully back on a bench with loose shoulders and stretched legs.
avoid: a person lying in bed with closed eyes (slapen); a person sitting upright at a table (zitten); a person on a cushion with a book (lezen); a cup or a phone in the hand; zzz marks.
alt: Iemand zit achterover op een bankje met de armen langs de rugleuning en de benen uitgestrekt.

scene: SKIP: striving is an inner aim with no single action; an arrow at a target or a climber would read as richten or klimmen.

one adult stands on the left leg in an empty yard, the right leg swung forward at the moment of impact, the foot just meeting a tin can that is lifting off the ground at the right. The adult looks at the can. No goal and no ball.
must: a swung foot meeting a can that is leaving the ground.
avoid: a ball shot into a goal (scoren); a leg lifted for a step, with the can untouched (lopen); a foot on a bicycle pedal (fietsen); a fist striking the can (slaan); speed lines or dust puffs.
alt: Iemand staat op een been en schopt met de andere voet tegen een blikje dat van de grond komt.

scene: one tall pile of boxes stands on the left and next to it a much lower pile of the same boxes on the right; one adult is lifting the top box off the left pile and carrying it away, the pile already half its first height.
must: a tall pile of boxes next to a much lower pile with one box being lifted off.
avoid: a pile of boxes growing taller (stapelen); a person tipping a box over (storten); an empty floor with no boxes (leeg); a person putting a box on the pile (zetten); a person throwing a box away (weggooien).
alt: Iemand tilt de bovenste doos van een hoge stapel af; naast de stapel staat al een veel lagere.

scene: one adult follows through after a shot on a small grass pitch, standing on the left leg with the right leg still swinging up; a football sits in the back of a goal net at the right, the net bulging behind it, and the goalkeeper is not drawn.
must: a football lying in the net of a goal, with the kicker still in follow-through.
avoid: a foot hitting a tin can in a yard (trappen); a person dribbling a ball down the pitch (voetballen); a player with raised arms and a trophy (winnen); a ball flying wide of the goal; a scoreboard.
alt: Iemand zwaait na een schot het been door; de bal ligt achter in het net van een doel.

scene: SKIP: processing has no single action: it means working material, digesting news or coping, and each picture would read as a different verb.
SKIP: getting used to something is a gradual inner change with no single moment to draw.
SKIP: promoting is abstract; a person lifted a step up a ladder would read as klimmen or a job promotion rather than the verb.

one adult stands in an empty street holding a video camera on one shoulder, one eye at the viewfinder, the lens pointing right at a small ball rolling along the ground. The camera is a boxy shoulder model with a wide lens hood and a side screen. Nothing else in the picture.
must: a video camera on a shoulder, aimed at a moving ball.
avoid: a phone held up for a still picture (fotograferen); a person watching a television (kijken); a spotlight and a clapper board; a flash; a tripod with nobody behind it.
alt: Iemand houdt een videocamera op de schouder, een oog tegen de zoeker, en richt de lens op een rollende bal.

scene: two neighbours pass each other on a pavement; each lifts one open hand to shoulder height and gives a small nod, both smiling.
must: two people passing, each with one open hand lifted to shoulder height.
avoid: an arm swung high over the head from far away (zwaaien); two people with arms around each other (omarmen); two people kissing on the cheek (kussen); two people talking (praten).
alt: Twee voorbijgangers knikken en steken elk een open hand op schouderhoogte omhoog.
column6: Ik groet de buurman als ik hem zie.
column7: I greet the neighbour when I see him.

scene: one adult sits at a plain table with both arms folded and the chin pulled back, the brows pulled hard together and the mouth turned down; on the plate in front of them lies one single floret of broccoli drawn as a small tree, and a fork lies beside the plate.
must: folded arms and a hard frown above a plate with one small tree-shaped vegetable.
avoid: a person eating with a happy face (smaken); a person pushing a plate away with a flat hand (weigeren); a person shouting with open mouth (schreeuwen); a person holding the stomach (kotsen).
alt: Iemand zit met de armen over elkaar en een diepe frons voor een bord met één klein boomvormig stukje groente.

scene: one adult stands facing a closed plain door and knocks on it with the knuckles of a bent hand held at head height, the other arm hanging at the side; the door has a handle and no window, no sign, and no bell. Only the person and the door are in the picture.
avoid: a hand pressing a doorbell (bellen); a hand turning the handle (openen); a fist hitting a person (slaan); a mallet on a nail (hameren); sound marks.
alt: Iemand staat voor een dichte deur en tikt met de knokkels van een gebogen hand tegen het hout.
